No Arabic letters ي/ك remain; «» guillemets used for any quotes; ZWNJ used where required.

02.prompt: Translate to Persian and keep the dialogue casual and colloquial, the way a real person speaks: "Go on, now," he said. "This is grown-ups' time. Go read one of your books."
